title: Settings: list + one page, no grey lines
question: Which way of separating settings feels best without grey lines?

variants.label: Soft rows
variants.notes: Every setting sits in its own soft tinted row with small gaps between them. All: left list jumps to and highlights the section you are reading, the search filters live, switches save with a toast. No grey lines.

variants.label: Tinted blocks
variants.notes: Each section is one tinted block, settings inside are separated only by space. All: left list jumps to and highlights the section you are reading, the search filters live, switches save with a toast. No grey lines.

variants.label: Open space
variants.notes: No backgrounds at all, just whitespace and bigger section titles; a row lights up when you hover it. All: left list jumps to and highlights the section you are reading, the search filters live, switches save with a toast. No grey lines.
